original_test_intent: Run the approved DCGM targeted-stress workload at a defined load and duration and prove all subtests complete while platform cooling, power delivery and GPU/host health remain inside hard limits.
original_method: Pin driver/DCGM and script; resolve source level 4 versus stress level 6 and expected engines/load; baseline ambient, fans, GPU/CPU/NVSwitch temperatures, power, PSU headroom/redundancy and errors; drain workloads, preserve logs, verify OOB; run once with synchronized telemetry and hard stops; cool down and verify full recovery.
manual_activity: Thermal/power and GPU owners approve stress level, load duration and absolute abort limits; operator confirms cooling, redundant power, OOB, workload drain and cooldown recovery.
required_inputs: Pinned targeted-stress script and exact load/engine/duration
Hard abort thresholds and sampling cadence
Dedicated maintenance, OOB and recovery plan
safety_requirements: Do not start without validated cooling and power headroom
Preserve complete diagnostic and telemetry evidence
agent_execution_scope: Validate selected scope, script, capacity, thresholds and approval
Confirm workload drain and OOB recovery
Run one approved stress test under telemetry
Cool down, restore state and report without verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Level 6 may implement targeted stress, but it conflicts with source level 4 and omits the pinned script, setup and complete critical safety envelope.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Execute the one approved pinned stress command only after capacity and hard-stop gates pass, capturing full output and time-aligned telemetry.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Targeted stress, 120-minute machine allowance and every-subtest PASS remain; scope is held for decision.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind declared load/engines/duration to continuous cooling, PSU, thermal, power and error telemetry with independent hard-stop and cooldown verification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds scope choice, capacity proof, synchronized telemetry and emergency recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Targeted power is not equivalent to targeted stress; neither level may silently replace the source.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Sustained load can overheat components, trip power paths, crash GPUs/host or expose latent faults.

project_override_considerations: Thermal/power engineering must publish ambient and per-sensor thresholds, PSU/feed headroom, fan policy, throttle/error allowance and exact hard-stop behavior for this platform.
expected_evidence: Complete stress output/exits and subtest results
Cooldown/final health/restored state and engineer verdict

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; execution blocks if authoritative scope/load, cooling or PSU capacity, hard stops, isolation, OOB or recovery cannot be established.
